decisions.why: Examples name Carbon Fibre AFOs (Pace Line, A-Pace) and Seattle Skride, Trulife's K3/K4 prosthetic foot system.
Head protectors, armboards, lithotomy and supine positioning are operating-table positioning consumables.
Armboard pads and arm protectors are operating-table positioning consumables (Oasis/Azure pad range).
Crutch stirrup pads and leg positioners are operating-table positioning consumables for lithotomy/leg support.
Latex-free resistance exercise bands are therapy and exercise equipment.
Colour-coded (red) dementia-specific walking frames and adjustable sticks are walking aids.
Patient positioning belts and universal/extremity positioners are operating-table positioning consumables.
Trio, Duogel and high-profile named cushions are pressure-relieving seating cushions.
The Trendelenburg System plus long armboard pad and nerve protectors are operating-table positioning kit.
Education videos cover the Seattle Skride prosthetic foot, the Matrix AFO drop-foot system, and Pectus Pro/Hyperextension trunk bracing.
Foam roll, universal, prone-pad and headrest positioners are operating-table positioning consumables.
Oasis+ discs, heel pads and armboard pads are operating-table pressure-care positioning pads.
Children's wheeled and unwheeled walking frames are paediatric walking aids.
Energy bolt kits, laminating cores, foot spacers and Symes nuts are prosthetic limb fabrication components.
DynaPro Flex Elbow, SoftPro gel elbow, humeral fracture orthosis and Gunslinger are upper-limb bracing/splints.
Double-ended adapters at set millimetre sizes are prosthetic limb build components.
Universal positioner and flat-bottom chest rolls are operating-table positioning consumables.
Extra heavy duty folding walking frame and heavy duty frames are bariatric-rated walking aids.
Extension legs, frame stubs and aluminium extensions are walking-frame accessory components.
Wheels and wheel units for walking frames are walking-aid accessory components.
Valve and lamination refurb kits and a lamination dummy are prosthetic fabrication/refurbishment components.
Incubator pad and head & torso operating table pad are operating-table positioning consumables.
Large and standard prone positioners are operating-table positioning consumables.
Profile pads and perineal table pad are operating-table pressure-care consumables.
Children's crutches and elbow crutches are paediatric walking aids.
Gutter/trough crutches are walking aids.
Gelcell and Gelcell G2 are gel pressure-relieving cushion products.
Endoskeletal cosmesis covers in light/dark are prosthetic limb cosmetic components.
Lateral positioner and lateral positioner pad are operating-table positioning consumables.
Child's Play Energy foot components are prosthetic limb components.
Mounting plate and socket attachment block are prosthetic limb build components.
Elite Table Pads are operating-table positioning consumables.
Oasis Standard Operating Table Pads are operating-table positioning consumables.
Azure Sacral Protector sits in the same operating-table pressure-care pad range as the rest of the Pressurecare line.
Elite Closed Head Rings are operating-table headrest positioning consumables.
Adult foot spacer is a prosthetic limb fabrication component.
Foot pyramid is a prosthetic alignment/build component.
3-Prong Adapter is a prosthetic limb build component.
Pneu-Trac Traction Collar is a cervical traction orthosis.
